Welcome to the subverse. Many of you may know just how difficult it is to categorise music. So I thought it would be a great idea to have a whole range of music shared here. Instead of splitting up Nu-Jazz and Future Jazz as separate subverses, both styles are here because the community will be small for at least a while. It's a good way of sharing music in a way that perhaps may introduce people to other styles. Some may love Jazzy House while never hearing a good Electro-Jazz track. This place hopes to change that.

Enjoy your time here, and please link what you feel! Hopefully this can be a place where there's as little moderation as possible.
